description: The Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem is the European Union's open platform for data from the Copernicus Sentinel missions and more, replacing the former access hubs with instant access and processing close to the data. It offers Sentinel mission data, Copernicus service products, contributing missions, federated and complementary data sets, a STAC catalogue, the Copernicus Browser, APIs, a data workspace for on-demand products, product traceability, hosted JupyterLab, openEO and Sentinel Hub, and an Ecosystem Services Registry for third-party applications. Coverage is global Earth observation of land, oceans and atmosphere. Format and access: browsing is open, and a free account unlocks downloads and processing quotas, with paid tiers through registered services. Licence: Copernicus free and open data policy. Caveats: quotas limit heavy processing, and the platform is an access point, not a curated infrastructure data set. It is the main source of satellite imagery for hazard exposure mapping and emergency response around infrastructure. Related catalogue records are the Copernicus Emergency Management Service and the European Ground Motion Service.
